integrity: Proof of all finite orders is analytic; exact rational enumeration independently checks n=4 through n=7 and seven rational edge densities. This finite test is not an infinite certificate.
scientific_limitations: All assertions concern the conditional even-degree Erdos-Renyi measure on complete graphs, n at least four and p strictly between zero and one. The full literature priority status is unresolved and two source papers do not certify absence of an implicit older formula.
title: Parity-controlled edge-correlation phases in random even complete graphs
